multiNode.description:
If true, retrieves actions via remote calls to c3 server nodes. You may specify individual nodes with the `nodes` field.
If false, retrieves actions from the current {@link App.Node node}.

nodes.description: If multiNode, list of nodes to draw from. By default, we will draw from all nodes in the current {@link App}.

actionId.description:
C3 action ID of the root action
If null (by default), all actions will be returned
If `actionId` is not a root action (ie. no actions have `actionId` as their actionRoot or asyncRoot), returns all actions sharing a root (actionRoot and asyncRoot) with `actionId`.

limit.description: Number of lines that will be streamed from log. (Note some logs may occupy multiple lines) Use -1 to return all.
